title: Ep. Afr. 2–5: Hebrew copies vs church books; Job and other pluses
english: You objected that I used Susanna as if unaware some call it uncanonical. I answer from the wider fact: in many holy books we find more or less than the Hebrews transmit — in Job and elsewhere verses stand with us that are absent there, and the church’s edification has long received these books. Still I do not refuse to search the Jewish copies; I refuse to [[move the ancient landmarks >> Bible:Proverbs 22:28]] set for the churches.

title: Ep. Afr. 6–10: Susanna’s Greek wordplay; elders; Spirit in the story
english: The story’s Greek plays on names and trees are not a decisive strike against it; translation and retelling can carry such features. The Spirit’s work in exposing the elders and vindicating Susanna fits the God who [[rescues the innocent >> Bible:Daniel 13:60-62]] and judges false witness.

title: Ep. Afr. 11–18: Church use; closing counsel — AFRICANUS CLOSEOUT
english: I do not scorn Hebrew truth, yet I will not surrender to a few what the churches have held for building up those [[bought with a price >> Bible:1 Corinthians 6:20]]. Use both care and charity: test the copies, keep the peace of the churches, and let love for those for whom Christ died govern the dispute. AFRICANUS CLOSEOUT.
